name: Proving Grounds 24: The Windward Colonnade. A broad island in a high wind, crowned by a ruined temple platform: a stair climbs each side to it, a colonnade stands round its rim, and its floor has fallen through to the open sky in the middle; beyond it a crack splits the island, and only two rope bridges cross to the east dais and its altar.
